label: Week 39, 2026
recap:
This week in AI policy and litigation was quiet, with 23 bill movements and 13 case updates across five jurisdictions. The United States Congress accounted for 13 of these, followed by Pennsylvania with 4, California with 3, Michigan with 2, and New Jersey with 1. Privacy and data was the most common theme at 7, alongside Children and minors and Safety and frontier models at 4 each.

Employment and hiring and Transparency and disclosure each appeared 3 times, while Workforce and education reached 2. Consumer protection and discrimination and Criminal law each appeared once, and 6 bills carried no theme. No federal documents were issued.
